metadata.question: Does Eastern Canada have higher carbon monoxide concentration on June 5th 2023 than June 1st 2023?

<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Dataset: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO (fallback: COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_CO)
- Dates: 2023-06-01 and 2023-06-05 (daily)
- Location: Eastern Canada = Intersection of Canada boundary (FAO GAUL 2015 level0) with a bounding box [-92,41] to [-52,60]

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use qa_value > 0.5 mask to filter valid CO retrievals. No cloud masking needed for CO.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after fallback => C1
- If valid pixel count after QA masking == 0 => C2
- If mean is null/NaN => C3
- Otherwise compare means: Jun 5 > Jun 1 => A, else B
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function evaluateAsync(eeObj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      eeObj.evaluate((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v)));
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const box = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-92, 41, -52, 60], null, false);
  const canada = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Canada'))
    .geometry();
  const region = canada.intersection(box, ee.ErrorMargin(1000));
  const scale = 3000;

  async function statsForDate(dateStr) {
    const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const end = start.advance(1, 'day');

    let source = 'OFFL';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO').filterDate(start, end);
    let count = await evaluateAsync(col.size());
    if (!count || count === 0) {
      source = 'NRTI';
      col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_CO').filterDate(start, end);
      count = await evaluateAsync(col.size());
      if (!count || count === 0) {
        return { status: 'C1', date: dateStr, source: 'NONE', images: 0 };
      }
    }

    const img = col.mean(); // daily composite if multiple
    const band = 'CO_column_number_density';
    const qa = img.select('qa_value');
    const masked = img.updateMask(qa.gt(0.5));

    const totalCount = await evaluateAsync(
      img.select(band).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band)
    );

    const validCount = await evaluateAsync(
      masked.select(band).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band)
    );

    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      return {
        status: 'C2',
        date: dateStr,
        source: source,
        images: count,
        totalCount: totalCount || 0,
        validCount: 0
      };
    }

    const meanCO = await evaluateAsync(
      masked.select(band).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get(band)
    );

    if (meanCO === null || Number.isNaN(meanCO)) {
      return { status: 'C3', date: dateStr, source: source, images: count, totalCount, validCount };
    }

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      date: dateStr,
      source: source,
      images: count,
      totalCount,
      validCount,
      mean: meanCO
    };
  }

  try {
    const d1 = await statsForDate('2023-06-01');
    const d5 = await statsForDate('2023-06-05');

    // Prints (<=20 lines)
    if (d1.status === 'C1') console.log('2023-06-01 Images: 0 (No data after OFFL/NRTI fallback)');
    else console.log(`2023-06-01 Source: ${d1.source}, Images: ${d1.images}, Total px: ${d1.totalCount||0}, Valid px: ${d1.validCount||0}, Mean CO: ${d1.mean!==undefined?d1.mean.toFixed(6):'NA'}`);

    if (d5.status === 'C1') console.log('2023-06-05 Images: 0 (No data after OFFL/NRTI fallback)');
    else console.log(`2023-06-05 Source: ${d5.source}, Images: ${d5.images}, Total px: ${d5.totalCount||0}, Valid px: ${d5.validCount||0}, Mean CO: ${d5.mean!==undefined?d5.mean.toFixed(6):'NA'}`);

    // Determine failure codes
    if (d1.status === 'C1' || d5.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('C1'); return;
    }
    if (d1.status === 'C2' || d5.status === 'C2') {
      console.log('C2'); return;
    }
    if (d1.status === 'C3' || d5.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('C3'); return;
    }

    // Final comparison
    const diff = d5.mean - d1.mean;
    console.log(`Diff (Jun 5 - Jun 1): ${diff.toFixed(6)}`);

    if (!Number.isFinite(diff)) {
      console.log('C3'); return;
    }

    console.log(diff > 0 ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
